item.title: Sampled-Based Guided Quantum Walk: Non-variational quantum algorithm for combinatorial optimization
item.description:
📚 Quantum
👤 Ugo Nzongani, Dylan Laplace Mermoud, Giuseppe Di Molfetta, and Andrea Simonetto
Quantum 10, 2234 (2026). https://doi.org/10.22331/q-2026-10-13-2234 We introduce SamBa-GQW, a novel quantum algorithm for solving binary combinatorial optimization problems of arbitrary degree with no use of any classical optimizer. The algorithm is based on a continuous-time quantum walk on the solution space represented as a graph. The walker explores the solution space to find its way to vertices that minimize the cost function of the optimization problem. The key novelty of our algorithm is an offline classical sampling protocol that gives information about the spectrum of the problem Hamiltonian. Then, the extracted information is used to guide the walker to high quality solutions via a quantum walk with a time-dependent hopping rate. We investigate the performance of SamBa-GQW on se…
